correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication gives a₀b₀=0 and, for each leaf i, aᵢbᵢ=0 and a₀βᵢ+αᵢbᵢ=0. At a₀=0 the alternatives bᵢ=0 or (aᵢ,αᵢ)=0 give the linear pieces Z_T and dimension 3r+1−|T|. Off a₀=0, b₀=0 and each of the 2^r open pieces is G_m × A^(2r), by eliminating βᵢ for i in S. For its proposed closure with s=|S|, discard free variables: s equations in dimension 1+3s give every component dimension at least 1+2s by the height bound. The a₀=0 fiber is the product of crosses uᵢvᵢ=0 with s free β coordinates and has dimension 2s, so no component is confined there. The irreducible open piece is dense, giving exactly X_S and dimension 2r+1. Choosing nonzero aᵢ or bᵢ according to the index masks distinguishes members of each family; a₀≠0 on an X_S and available b₀≠0 on a Z_T rule out cross-family containments. Stratifying disjointly by a₀ and bᵢ, the per-leaf classes are L²+(L−1)L on the open and L³+(L−1)L on the closed slice, with initial factors L−1 and L. These strata are defined over k and have the claimed classes without counting overlaps. Substituting q^m gives all extension counts and expanding the formal logarithm gives the zeta product. In particular r=2 yields 236 and 3717 at q=2 and q=3.
residual_risks: The classification is of the reduced one-sided locus; it does not determine possible scheme multiplicities or embedded components.

value.rationale: This is a complete, uniform classification for a natural sparse family, rather than one small field instance. The precise non-equidimensional component census and treatment of the degeneration at a₀=0 give useful information unavailable from just an arithmetic count or an ambient upper-triangular comparison. The disjoint strata supply the exact motivic and extension-count invariants for the same object.
residual_risks: No extrapolation to general posets, arbitrary quivers or unreduced schemes; a covered subcase or known arithmetic check alone would not justify the same assessment.
